findings.citation_text: Wang et al. [12] utilized radio-frequency identification (RFID) to receive the speaker's vibration signal in the environment. This approach requires a preinstalled tag in the victim's room.
findings.reasoning: The citing paper cites [12] as an example of passive sensing, describing its use of RFID to capture speaker vibrations. The text categorizes the work and notes a requirement (preinstalled tag), but does not evaluate its quality or use it as a foundation for the current work.
